description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, operating since 2005 with 385+ locations nationwide. The Williams Lake location sits on Cariboo Highway (Highway 97), a key cycling corridor through the Cariboo region. Cyclists can build customizable Mexican-inspired burritos, bowls, and tacos from fresh in-house ingredients, with delivery also available via DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, and Uber Eats.
